player_prompt.intro: Ị bụ onye na-egwu {player_id} na Nim. Ihe mgbaru ọsọ gị bụ iji ihe ikpeazụ fọdụrụ. Na nke ọ bụla, họrọ kpọmkwem otu ikpo ma wepụ otu ma ọ bụ karịa ihe site na ya. Jiri usoro '[pile quantity]', ebe ikpo bụ nchịkọta nchịkọta na ọnụọgụ bụ ọnụ ọgụgụ nke ihe iji wepụ. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, '[0 3]' na-ewepụ ihe 3 site na ikpo 0.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Enweghị usoro mbugharị ziri ezi achọtara. Jiri '[pile quantity]'.
invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: Onye na-egwu egwu {player_id}, Ihe na-abaghị uru. Kọlụm {col} dị n'èzí.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Pile index {pile_index} is out of range.
invalid_move.non_positive: A ghaghị iwepụ ma ọ dịkarịa ala otu ihe.
invalid_move.exceeds_pile: Enweghi ike iwepu {quantity} site na ikpo {pile_index} (naanị {pile_count} ekpe).

observation.removed_from_piles: Player {player_id} played [{pile_index} {quantity}], removing {quantity} object(s) from pile {pile_index}.

outcome.win: Onye na-egwu egwu {player_id} were ihe ikpeazụ ahụ!
